title: Durable delivery ledger for outbound messages
summary: Outbound message delivery is recorded in a durable ledger so ambiguous outcomes are recoverable.

protected.asset: Outbound message integrity and operator trust in delivery claims
protected.failure: A delivery failure or duplicate is invisible, so the operator repeats or loses outward communication without knowing.

rationale: Wherever the deployment sends messages, the ambiguous-outcome rule demands a record: a write response proves only that a call returned. A durable per-message ledger with recovery-on-restart turns ambiguous delivery into a bounded reconciliation step instead of a guess.

variants.description: Enable the deployment's delivery ledger feature where the build provides it, and read the value back.
Maintain an append-only delivery log at the integration boundary with idempotency keys per outbound message.

verification.method: Read the delivery ledger setting back; where recovery is configurable, exercise a restart canary on an isolated target and confirm undelivered entries reconcile rather than vanish.
verification.evidence: Setting read-back and the isolated restart reconciliation outcome; no message contents.

rollback.method: Restore the previous setting; an external ledger is retired only after confirming no unreconciled entries remain.

failure_modes: The ledger is enabled but never queried, so failures still go unnoticed.
Recovery re-sends delivered messages because idempotency keys are absent.
Ledger retention is shorter than the operator's reconciliation window.

hermes_versions.notes: Synthetic seed control: the range is an illustrative placeholder for the example registry, not a verified compatibility claim.
